newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 4.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
ARMED POLICE CALLED IN BY SCHOOL
Armed police were called to a school in Paddington, west London, yesterday when it was reported that a 15-year old boy had threatened another pupil with a gun.
"FALSE POLICIES" BID TO SHARE NORWICH BONUS

Unprincipled financial advisers have been encouraging small investors to buy new Norwich Union insurance policies by falsely claiming that they would be eligible for a windfall bonus when the company floats on the stock market.
PORTMAN MANAGERS IN 21 MLN STG BUYOUT
Portman Travel, Britain's largest independent business travel agent, has been the subject of a 21.4 million stg buyout by managers backed by NatWest Ventures.
DOLLAR STUNG AS U.S. RUNS OUT OF STEAM
Disappointing U.S. economic statistics appear to support the US Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates at their present level.
JP MORGAN IS WINNING BATTLE OF THE "BULGE"
New rankings of Wall Street's top underwriters and advisers have placed JP Morgan ahead of "big six" banks like Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and CS First Boston in a number of different categories.
